title: Keep finished sessions with open human gates open on session use/new, naming doctor's decision fix (#181)
description: Keep finished sessions with open human gates open on session use/new, naming doctor's decision fix (#181)
acceptance_criteria: A finished session (stage done or native change finalized on HEAD) with a non-empty awaiting_human list and a finalized native change stays open on session new and session use and is reported in kept_open with its open-gate count and the recovery 'chough doctor --fix --reason <text>'; a finished session without open gates is archived unchanged as before; the existing inbox-unfolded kept-open behavior is unchanged. Regression: a switch with one gated finalized session and one ungated finalized session archives only the ungated one.
